name: pi-agent-talk
description: Agent-to-agent messaging for Pi over MACP 2.0: messages enter as attributed custom messages at the next inference boundary — never through the prompt box, never in the human's input history.

scripts.build: cd center && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npx tsc
scripts.test: node test/resolve.mjs && node test/tools.mjs && cd center && npm test && cd .. && bin/guard/test.sh && bin/guard/test-herdr.sh
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && git diff --exit-code center/dist && npm test
